issues.title: Unreadable existing portfolio is overwritten as an empty portfolio
issues.evidence: Real browser malformed local portfolio returns empty; saving a valid Bob session overwrites recoverable Alice raw bytes. Emergency backup preserves them before save but loses them afterward. Actual pagehide, hidden visibilitychange and explicit sync overwrite the raw portfolio with {} even without saving a new essay; three real-browser paths reproduced.

issues.title: Missing handwriting criterion is described as worst performance
issues.evidence: Actual-source injected response with one Missing handwriting criterion and explicit valid 8/10 fallback generates lowest-band criticism for the missing criterion, because Number(null) is 0. Actual-source getAuditScoreBandLabel(null/empty/whitespace) returns worst 4–5 band although unknown input should be unscored; used by audit display and validation.

issues.title: Student portfolio HTML export executes untrusted score and photo markup
issues.evidence: Actual createSingleStudentArchiveZip accepts portfolio JSON whose overall contains image markup and photo dataUrl breaks an attribute; opening its generated HTML executes two harmless onerror markers. Browser network fully intercepted. Zero scanner security findings did not detect this export boundary defect. Actual reassessment also executes accepted photo dataUrl attribute markup in unsanitized updateSelectedImagePreview.

issues.title: Remove unshipped helper copies and unused bundled helper islands
issues.evidence: 14 explicit source paths unreachable from index/runtime loading, two explicitly dual-tested fixtures; 84 baseline findings on helper copies and six in unused bundled helper island. Preserve shipped counterparts and test coverage. One additional original warning is on an earlier duplicate top-level chooseNewerSession declaration shadowed by the later runtime declaration.

issues.title: Delayed crop callback changes another student/photo after cancellation
issues.evidence: Real browser actual applyCrop; held native image load, cancel, select Bob and replace image, then release callback. Bob overwritten with Alice crop; original Alice untouched. Review open/reset crop callbacks and invalidation/owner handling.

issues.title: Same-image merge overwrites newer photo reference with older metadata
issues.evidence: Actual sync both local-newer and cloud-newer preserve newer originalText but replace same imageId driveFileId with older file. Root secondary field overlay in mergeSessionImageRefs; inspect missing media references and all callers, preserve distinct-image union.

issues.title: Untrusted photo identity key mutates Object.prototype during sync
issues.evidence: Actual sync with synthetic imageId __proto__ copies harmless marker to Object.prototype through same-image byKey dictionary. Related SYNC-003 helper; use safe dictionary identity handling and inspect analogous merged/byKey maps without removing valid images.

issues.title: In-flight grade change mixes original assessment metadata with current scoring policy
issues.evidence: Real browser Grade12 analysis, paused first AI request, switch visible grade to4. Original snapshot remains Grade12 while actual adjustment uses4;150 words/330 target/base8 returns4 versus expected5. Inspect all mutable assessment settings read after await; retain coherent snapshot or invalidate changed context, preserve valid pending work.

issues.title: Failed preference save is acknowledged and schedules sync
issues.evidence: A failed wft_settings write returns targetWordCount 300 while disk remains 200, advances the settings counter and schedules sync; no exception reaches the caller.
issues.scope: Ordinary preference saving outside the repaired student operations, when no recovery buffer is active.

issues.title: Unused archive-removal helper writes a mismatched legacy session marker
issues.evidence: With shipped student-ID mapping disabled, this auxiliary helper writes session::archive-a while the legacy portfolio filter looks for session:alice:archive-a. Local removal succeeds but the old cloud session remains visible to applyDeletionsToPortfolio.
issues.scope: The shipped auxiliary helper has no shipped caller; the current school-year archive UI uses clearCurrentClassAfterSuccessfulArchive instead.
